Name: Amittai
Summary: Amittai is named as the father of the prophet Jonah (Jonah 1:1), and Jonah is called 'son of Amittai' again in the history of Jeroboam II's reign, where his prophecy of Israel's restored borders came true.
KeyStory: Amittai's son Jonah, called 'son of Amittai,' was sent to Nineveh — and his earlier prophecy of Israel's borders had already proved true under Jeroboam II.
LifeLesson: Amittai's son ran from God and was still used by Him. A parent's legacy is not cancelled by a child's detour.
